verdict.rationale: The evidence pack has no documented baseline file, ignore list, or false-positive suppression mechanism. The `--only-verified` flag and `--results=verified,unknown` filter cut noise by verification status, and `--since-commit HEAD` limits the scan to recent commits. These are adjacent controls (verification filtering and incremental scan scope), not a way to baseline or mark specific existing or false-positive findings as ignored, so they earn no credit.

support.subject: As a security-engineer, I can baseline or ignore existing and false-positive findings so only new issues alert
